production_status: Fingerprint cache remains unchanged in this production revision. The isolated failing test was preserved as a patch/log then removed from the working source; this does not mark the bug fixed.

compiled_red.method: Actual Fingerprints::file called on a self-created9-byte file before and after an equal-size write with restored mtime. It returned the old hash.

affected_contract: Runtime hashes feed worker reuse and translation environment/cache keys; unknown runtime currently can become stable JSON null. No actual incorrect meeting output was demonstrated in this probe.
hot_path_constraint: Snapshots call cached captions under the Store lock. Rehashing a full runtime on every600ms snapshot is not an accepted fix.
required_followup: Separate admission-time complete bounded observation outside Store/prefs/global map locks from frequent current-receipt checks.
Use reliable ordinary-mutation observers/ownership for each OS, with exact release before component removal.
Unknown observations must make reuse ineligible, without breaking source display or literal captions.
Recheck model/runtime/configuration at generation and commit; do not treat a weak epoch as full driver/runtime identity.
